original_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: master app logo for SyscallGuard, a Linux kernel security desktop application. Create one exceptionally clean, original, flat geometric emblem, no text or letters outside the emblem. A compact angular shield silhouette with a precise negative-space S-shaped circuit/gate inside it: the impression is a protected boundary stopping an outbound signal. White opaque mark only, transparent background, centered in a square, generous clear margin approximately 15% on each side. Strong balanced silhouette, broad consistent strokes, restrained architectural geometry, crisp corners with slight optical softening. Must remain legible at 16px and suitable for tracing into true editable SVG paths. The app has a premium pure-black monochrome interface: no blue, no colorful accents, no glow, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no bevels, no 3D, no mockup, no watermark, no lettering, no presentation sheet, just one standalone white emblem on true transparency.
refinement_prompt: Edit this SyscallGuard logo into a perfectly clean flat vector-style app emblem. Preserve the recognizable shield silhouette and S-like two circuit terminals, but remove ALL distressed textures, speckles, scratches, noise, paint chips, outlines, and random holes. Every white shape must be uniformly solid fully opaque white, every negative-space region uniformly completely transparent. Simplify to a single balanced geometric shield outline joined to two broad S-shaped circuit rails with two solid circular terminals. Exactly flat white geometry on transparent background, crisp smooth edges, no gradients or shading, generous 15% margins on the square canvas. No text, no words, no background tile. This is a production app-icon master, not an illustration.
production_note: The image-generation concept is retained as generated-concept-v1.png. Production assets are rendered from the clean, hand-normalized editable vector branding/mark.svg, not from a bitmap wrapped in SVG.
